# Factions & Organizations

## Aid Society {#aid-society}

The Aid Society is a local group whose members, including women like Mrs. Jasper Bell, periodically gather at members' homes such as [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for meetings and tea.

**Members:** [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the orphaned twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), whose playful and rowdy behavior immediately poses a challenge for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md). At church on Sunday, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) creates a commotion by dropping a caterpillar down [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md) White's neck during the service. Later in the week, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) ruins Dora's dress by forcing her to walk the pigpen fence and pumps water over her, subsequently confessing to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that he also hid a toad in Marilla's bed.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

## Allans {#allans}

The Allans are guests and loved acquaintances of [Anne](../character/anne.md) who, along with Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), were invited to dinner at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

## American {#american}

The Americans are wealthy summer visitors, including artists and millionaires, who frequent local hotels like the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) for the coastal scenery.

## Blythes {#blythes}

The Blythes are a family, including John and his son [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), who are noted by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to be a very independent group of people.

## Boulters {#boulters}

The Boulters are a local family noted by [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) for having a strongly developed, contrary streak.

## Canadian Woman {#canadian-woman}

The Canadian Woman is a publication to which [Diana](../character/diana.md) suggests [Anne](../character/anne.md) send her written garden idyl.

## Conservative {#conservative}

The Conservatives, also known as Tories, are a Canadian political party whose platform and principles are aligned with the traditions of [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) residents such as [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

**Members:** [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md)

## Cottons {#cottons}

The Cottons are a family whose three pallid little girls were among the ten newcomers attending the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school.

## Cuthberts {#cuthberts}

The Cuthberts are a quiet and reserved family residing at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), a secluded and meticulously clean homestead situated at the edge of cleared land in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

## Debating Club {#debating-club}

[The Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Debating Club is a respectable local organization that meets fortnightly throughout the winter and hosts entertainments at the hall, such as a major paid concert featuring music, recitations, and an address by the minister to benefit the library.

## Grit {#grit}

The Grits are a political party in opposition to the [Conservatives](../codex/factions.md#conservative), supported by Prissy Andrews's father, Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), and some of the schoolboys.

**Members:** [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)

## Improvement Society {#improvement-society}

The Improvement Society is an [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) organization conceived by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and supported by local youth to make the village prettier through projects like cleaning up land, removing dilapidated structures, and repainting the hall.

**Members:** [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Di](../character/di.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) nervously visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to confess that she accidentally sold his Jersey cow to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md). To her relief, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) takes the mistake good-naturedly, accepts Anne's cow in exchange, and invites her to stay for tea. After sharing a pleasant conversation and bonding over cake and tea, [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to happily report the successful outcome to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v2 · III Mr. Harrison at Home

## Improvers {#improvers}

The Improvers, also known as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) (A.V.I.S.), is a flourishing local organization that works to beautify the community through projects such as clearing road fronts, planting flower beds, and petitioning for improvements to public and church grounds.

**Members:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks home with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who talks about church preparations, and upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learn from a letter that the twins will stay with them until fall. [Anne](../character/anne.md) recalls a humorous interaction with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) regarding his antics and misinterpretations of the catechism. Later, at an Improvers meeting, the group is distressed to hear that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence for advertisements, and an unsuccessful committee sent to reason with him leaves them dismayed.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

> [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), and Jane plead with [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to rent his fences for patent medicine ads, but he refuses. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally overhears Judson taking a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry.md) near the Lake of [Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#shining-waters). Fearing [Anne](../character/anne.md) will expose his corruption and ruin his reputation, Judson agrees to cancel the ad deal to keep her quiet, though [Anne](../character/anne.md) refuses to make a deal and simply keeps the secret out of principle.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) completes her school year and walks home, meeting young [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) on her way to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) cemetery. They discuss their loved ones, imagination, and placing flowers on graves. At the cemetery, [Anne](../character/anne.md) meets Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and the two walk home together while discussing teaching, ideals, friendship, and future plans.
>
> — v2 · XV The Beginning of Vacation

## Indian {#indian}

The Indians are a cultural group whose traditional headdresses, made of colorful feathers, are imitated by local schoolboys.

## Liberal {#liberal}

The Liberal party is a political group whose members include [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), old [Martin](../character/martin.md) Bovyer, and [Diana](../character/diana.md) Barry's father.

**Members:** [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)

## Presbyterian {#presbyterian}

The Presbyterian church is a religious organization whose attendance is considered a matter of conscience for the [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) family.

## Pyes {#pyes}

The Pyes are a localized group of four interconnected families known for being domineering, unsociable, and stubborn, whose members include Roger, Joshua, [John Andrew](../character/john-andrew.md), and Anthony.

## Sloanes {#sloanes}

The Sloanes are a family in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) whose members refused to deal with the Bell family after a dispute regarding their respective roles in a school concert program.

## Yankee {#yankee}

A Yankee refers to a person from or associated with the United [States](../codex/places.md#states), whom locals such as Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) view with skepticism and prejudice.
